track: Denoising Track, diagnostic batch DN-1 (LOW/HIGH noise attribution). No denoiser, no reconstruction, no training.
classification: Suffix of WL101 per the AGENTS.md numbering policy: a dependent evidence-gap follow-up of WL101A (32-spp attribution INCONCLUSIVE, recommended evaluating the full readout under LOW-HIGH correlation and the persistent HIGH error separately), WL101B and WL101C on the same fixture, checkpoint and estimator, introducing no mechanism. The research owner may reclassify; files would be renamed, not renumbered silently.

machine.host: local workstation (user instruction: local machine, not LabServer63)
machine.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 16 GB, driver 596.49, Windows 11; GPU shared with the desktop display (timings descriptive only)
machine.renderer_stack: Mitsuba 3.9.1 / Dr.Jit 1.5.0 from external/mi39_dyn101 (the stack rt101 was written for), cuda_ad_rgb, FREEZE=1
machine.stack_note: WL101A-C ran Mitsuba 3.8.0 / Dr.Jit 1.3.1 on LabServer63. Cross-stack equivalence is an admission gate (G2, G3), not assumed.

scene.fixture: WL100 SSS test config 0, light set 0 (= WL101A/WL101C cfg0), fixed geometry, light, material and camera
scene.construction: Fresh rt101.RT(cfg0) -> source() -> respond() (WL101 initialisation / arm C path). WL101 showed selective-lifecycle and fresh tables identical; G1 checks the table against the archived WL100 table_0.

references.physical: WL100 six-optical-domain-event physical reference, two independent halves REF_0_0 / REF_0_1, seeds 100901 / 100902, 4096 spp each, frozen WL100 runtime (Mitsuba 3.5.1). Events: e1, e2 (= physical LOW) and h = E3..E6 (= physical HIGH target of the learned table). Same fixture and definition as the WL101 halves used by WL101A/C (seeds 101100/101101, not stored locally); this batch uses the WL100 halves, so its bias numbers are an independent re-estimate, not a replay of WL101C.
references.component_compatibility: ECRO LOW = E1 + E2 uses the identical estimator as the reference's first two events (same RNG consumption for k = 1, 2), so LOW bias against e1 + e2 and HIGH bias against h are semantically aligned. The six-event truncation and WL100's limited native-volpath qualification bound physical interpretation; nothing here certifies absolute SSS accuracy.
references.historical_prediction: PRED_0, seed 100903, 4096 spp, frozen WL100 runtime, keys e1 e2 hl

signal_path.LOW: E1 + E2. E1: NEE (+ SSS entry-to-first-exit walk NEE at the sphere) at the first camera hit. E2: same at the second hit plus the ballistic through-sphere term generated at the first hit.
signal_path.HIGH: HL = throughput * B[patch(second hit), bin(-dir)] read at the second hit (pt100.trace, mode ecro, k = 2), before the k = 2 SSS walk.
signal_path.composed: Raw ECRO radiance = (E1 + E2 + HL) / spp, the WL101 / WL101B consumer contract (float32 on the device).

stochastic_stages.P: first-event transport: k = 1 SSS walk (distance / direction draws) and k = 1 closure sample or SSS exit (3 draws). Determines the second hit, throughput and thus HL and E2's prefix.
stochastic_stages.S: k = 2 SSS walk (only after the HL lookup) -> affects E2 only

signal_path.high_state: B = model(state rays, source encoding): state-ray and source-point offsets are a fixed table_seed 86001 draw shared by every patch, no runtime RNG. G1 tests repeated generation for bitwise identity (including the GPU float64 index_add_ source reduction).
signal_path.rng: Normal arm: one PCG32 stream per sample lane (Dr.Jit 0.4.6 seeding replica), seed * 1000003 (+ launch for render_hq), draws consumed J -> P -> S in order.

J_normal.outputs: 9 native channels (per-pixel sums) float32 + contract-composed RGB float32

PF_split.renderer: render_h.SplitRT.split_frame (diagnostic copy of _frame_prog; RNG wiring J / P / S streams, distinct stream selectors 1<<40, 2<<40, 3<<40; statements and per-stage draw order unchanged)
PF_split.seed_formula: base = 10185000 + 1000 * i_spp + 10 * r (i_spp 0, 1, 2 for 1, 4, 16 spp); J = base, P = base + 1, S = base + 2, S' = base + 3, P' = base + 4, S'' = base + 5
PF_split.role: Conditional stage diagnostic. Valid only if G6 and G7 pass. Never replaces the normal arm.

HQ_normal.renderer: rt101.render_hq (frozen, launches of 32 spp, seed * 1000003 + launch)
HQ_normal.split_for_stable_bias: group 1 = first four seeds, group 2 = last four

paired_low.compare: REF_0_0 / REF_0_1 e1 e2 (same rays and first two events)

Q_quadrature.role: Conditional sensitivity of the deterministic HIGH state to its frozen quadrature draw. Not a runtime noise source in the normal arm (its effect there is a fixed, seed-independent offset). Includes the generator's response to offsets it was not trained with, so it is an upper-side indication, not a clean quadrature error.

source_offset_redraws.factor: u_src (2 x PSRC offsets), state rays fixed

state_offset_redraws.factor: u_state (4 x K offsets), source offsets fixed; full state rebuild

Q_quadrature.draw: numpy default_rng(seed).random(shape, float32), the same call form as pt86.Ctx
Q_quadrature.readout: Common random numbers: render_hq HL at 1024 spp, seed 10189401, for the original and each redrawn table; Delta HL is exactly the readout of Delta B on identical paths
Q_quadrature.restore: Original offsets restored and the table re-checked bitwise against the original before any later stage

timing.what: Synchronized wall per frame for rt.frame + 9-channel readback, readback alone, contract composition, split_frame + readback; 4 warm-up then 32 measured frames per spp
timing.scope: Descriptive instrumentation overhead on a desktop GPU; no latency claim

arms.dynamic_check: NOT RUN. Locally stored references cover WL100 test configs 0-2, which differ in both geometry and light (no single-factor edit pair); the qualified WL101 tour references are on the servers and execution is local by user instruction. Decided before evidence.

rois.source: Geometry only. WL100 cfg0 center-ray gbuffer map_0.npz (shape ids identical to an own center-ray trace, checked in development) and an 8 x 8 fixed-subpixel first-hit id buffer from the same scene. Decided before any noise statistic was computed; the archived physical reference mean was viewed only to place the control region.

definitions.sss_interior: WL101A sphere_interior (sphere eroded by 4 px, 8-neighbour) and full 8 x 8 sphere coverage
definitions.silhouette: Pixels with sphere coverage strictly between 0 and 1 in the 8 x 8 subpixel id buffer (mixed coverage, both sides of the sphere outline)
definitions.near: WL101C near: visible front-half floor (center-ray y <= 0.4 m) within 0.18 m planar distance of the support point (0.9, 0.4, 0) — the contact / indirect-illumination region with the reproduced HIGH overbrightness
definitions.control: Back wall (sid 2), pure 8 x 8 coverage, >= 0.3 m from every room edge, >= 0.5 m from the sphere surface, >= 0.3 m from both boxes, not in contact_shadow: directly lit diffuse wall away from contact and silhouettes
definitions.WL101A_WL101C: full, sphere, sphere_boundary, floor, contact_shadow, flank exactly as WL101A common.masks and WL101C make_regions

gates.G0_inputs: Every frozen input SHA-256 matches; versions recorded.
gates.G1_high_state: Table vs archived table_0 B: relative L1 <= 1e-4. Three repeated source+respond evaluations bitwise identical. Table bitwise unchanged after all frames.
gates.G2_prediction_replay: Seed 100903 at 4096 spp vs PRED_0: relative L1 <= 1e-4 for full, LOW, HIGH, E1, E2 in full frame and every primary ROI.
gates.G3_paired_low: Seeds 100901 / 100902 at 4096 spp: E1, E2 and LOW vs REF_0_h e1, e2: relative L1 <= 1e-4 in full frame and every primary ROI.
gates.G4_determinism: Normal arm: replicate 0 of every spp re-rendered bitwise identical. Split arm: triple 0 member A re-rendered bitwise identical.
gates.G5_recomposition: Per J frame: contract-composed RGB vs float64 (E1 + E2 + HL) / spp relative L1 <= 1e-6. Variance identity V_T = V_L + V_H + 2 C_LH with V_T computed from the contract-composed image: |residual| <= 1e-5 * V_T in every ROI and spp.
gates.G6_split_structure: Every PF triple: E1 and HL of A and B bitwise identical (they depend on J and P only); all values finite and >= 0.
gates.G7_split_equivalence: PF member-A vs J normal, per primary ROI x spp x component (T, L, H): (a) ROI-mean variance ratio, |log ratio| / SE <= z(0.05/36) using bootstrap SEs of both arms; (b) ROI-mean RGB mean difference, |diff| / SE <= z(0.05/36). Any failure: PF stage results are reported as INVALID and excluded from interpretation; normal-arm results stand.
gates.G8_tests: tests_h.py passes (synthetic known-moment, pick-freeze, stable-bias, bootstrap-coverage and mask tests).
gates.failure: G0-G6 or G8 failure stops the evidence run; no threshold relaxation. A G2/G3 failure caused by the cross-stack difference is reported as a blocker, not amended away.

analysis.convention: Linear HDR RGB, no clamping, tonemapping or outlier removal. ROI aggregate = mean over ROI pixels and the three channels of the per-element moment.
analysis.components: E1, E2, L = E1 + E2, H = HL, T = contract-composed (J arm) or E1 + E2 + HL in float64 (PF arm).
analysis.joint_moments: Per ROI and spp: ddof=1 inter-seed variances V_E1, V_E2, V_L, V_H, V_T; covariances C_LH, C_E1E2, C_E1H, C_E2H; correlation rho_LH = C_LH / sqrt(V_L V_H) (ROI-aggregated moments); per-component ROI means. Signed shares s_L = V_L / V_T, s_H = V_H / V_T, s_C = 2 C_LH / V_T (sum 1, s_C may be negative). Relative variance = V / mean(ref_T^2) over the ROI (WL101A normalisation).
analysis.spp_scaling: log V vs log spp least-squares slope per component (L, H, T, and |2 C_LH| reported signed separately) with bootstrap SE; spp-scaled n * V.
analysis.stage_decomposition: PF arm per ROI and spp: stage matrices J, P, S for (E1, E2, H, T) and L by linearity; stage shares of V_T; C_LH split by stage (S stage exactly 0 by construction).
analysis.bias: HQ arm vs the two physical halves: stable squared bias matrix over (L, H, T) by the two-pairing cross product (group means of seeds 1-4 and 5-8 against distinct halves); b2_T = b2_L + b2_H + 2 b_LH. Signed ROI-mean bias (RGB and Rec.709 luminance) with Welch interval (8 HQ seeds vs 2 halves, per WL101C). Reference-mean noise = mean (R1 - R2)^2 / 4. HQ ensemble-mean noise = V_T(HQ) / 8. Stable bias significance is judged against its spatial-block bootstrap SE (16 x 16 blocks within the ROI, 2000 draws).
analysis.mse_budget: At each spp: MSE_T(n) = V_T(n) + b2_T. Bias share = b2_T / MSE_T(n).
analysis.uncertainty: Replicate bootstrap, 2000 draws, seed 10189999 (J arm and PF triples resampled independently per spp); normal 95% intervals point +- 1.96 SE (tests_h.py coverage check). Bias: spatial-block bootstrap as above.
analysis.temporal: Static fixed-camera raw frames carry no state between frames, so frame-to-frame instability equals the inter-seed variance; reported as such, not separately sampled.

per_roi_and_spp: BIAS-DOMINANT if the lower 95% bound of b2_T / MSE_T(n) > 0.5.
Otherwise, sampling attribution from the J arm: LOW-DOMINANT if lower95(s_L) > 0.5; HIGH-DOMINANT if lower95(s_H) > 0.5; COVARIANCE-DOMINATED if lower95(s_C) > 0.5 or upper95(s_C) < -0.5.
Otherwise MIXED if at least two of s_L, s_H, |s_C| have lower 95% bounds (for s_C: of its sign-consistent magnitude) above 0.2.
Secondary flags: 'bias resolved' if lower95(b2_T) > 0 by its block SE; 'covariance resolved' if the s_C interval excludes 0.
verdict_rules.stage_rule: PF arm, if valid: JITTER-, PREFIX- or SUFFIX-DOMINANT if the lower 95% bound of that stage's share of V_T > 0.5; else MIXED-STAGE if two stages have lower bounds > 0.2; else INCONCLUSIVE.
verdict_rules.overall: REGION-DEPENDENT if primary ROIs receive different classes at the same spp; otherwise the common class. Report each spp separately.
verdict_rules.scope: Classifications describe candidate noise responsibilities for this fixture, checkpoint and camera. They do not establish denoiser utility or select LOW-only, HIGH-only or joint reconstruction.

display.transfer: WL101A: (e x / (1 + e x))^(1/2.2) on linear HDR, display only
display.maps: Variance maps: RGB-mean per-pixel variance, square-root display on one absolute scale shared by all variance maps of the batch, real-unit colorbar; signed covariance and bias maps diverging around 0 with one shared cap; no per-image normalisation.
